question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
the correct answer is "**around**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words.
 
 
• **around**: approximately. it is an adverb.
 
• **more or less**: mostly or nearly.
 
• **roughly**: in a violent or angry way
 
• **just**: now, very soon, or very recently
 
 
 
• ​​As per the meaning of the given words, "**around**" is the appropriate word choice for the blank.
 
• In the given sentence, the speaker is trying to give an approximate estimate of the number of relatives. So "around" is the correct word choice.

​Hence, the correct answer is **option 1.**

The complete passage is: Football legend Diego Maradona was buried in a private ceremony after a day of *(1) emotional* scenes in the Argentine capital Buenos Aires. Only* (2) around* two dozen relatives and close friends *(3) attended* the final ceremony on Thursday. But *(4) earlier *huge crowds turned out to pay (5) their respects, with many weeping, blowing kisses and praying as they filed past his coffin.
